meta.source: Ops Check Good — situation routing cards
meta.notes: Routing only. Each card names where to start, what else commonly applies, and what to establish first — it never diagnoses and never states policy. Drafted from the maintainer’s brief; the routings are the obvious ones and have NOT been checked against local guidance, which is why this stays status=stub. A Shirt reviewing this file should expect to move a few of the "start here" choices. referenceIds are empty until references.json is filled in.

situations.label: Is in crisis or talking about hurting themselves
questions: Is the Airman safe right now, and is someone with them?
Does this need a response now rather than an appointment?
Who else in the chain of command has to be told, and when?

situations.label: Cannot pay their bills
questions: Is there an immediate basic-needs problem — food, power, somewhere to sleep?
Is this caused by a pay problem rather than a budgeting one?
Is the member mid-PCS, with entitlements not yet settled?

situations.label: Needs emergency financial assistance
questions: What is the specific expense, and by when?
Has the member already been to Finance about it?

situations.label: Has a pay problem
questions: What exactly is wrong — amount, entitlement, or a missing payment?
Which documents does the member already have in hand?
Has anything changed recently: PCS, promotion, dependant status?

situations.label: Is having problems at home
questions: Is anyone at risk of harm?
Does the member want confidential support, or a formal referral?
Are children involved?

situations.label: Is going through a divorce
questions: Are dependants enrolled who will be affected?
Does anything need changing on record — allotments, beneficiaries, records?
Is there a family care plan requirement?

situations.label: Needs childcare
questions: Is this routine cover, shift work, or a one-off?
Is the member on a waiting list already?

situations.label: Has a family emergency
questions: Has a Red Cross message been initiated?
Is emergency leave or funded travel in play?
Who is covering the member’s duties?

situations.label: Needs legal assistance
questions: Is this a personal civil matter or something tied to duty?
Is there a deadline or court date?

situations.label: Is having trouble with their landlord
questions: Is the member in on-base housing or off-base?
Is the home currently habitable?
Has anything been put in writing to the landlord?

situations.label: Needs PCS help
questions: Where are they in the process — orders, household goods, travel, in-processing?
Are there dependants, pets, or EFMP considerations?

situations.label: Has an EFMP issue
questions: Is the member enrolled already?
Is an assignment or an assignment limitation involved?

situations.label: Needs confidential counselling
questions: Does the member understand which options are confidential and which are not?
Is this something that can wait for an appointment?

situations.label: Is dealing with workplace conflict
questions: Is a protected category alleged?
Has it been raised in the chain of command already?
Does the member want resolution or a formal complaint?
